name: neurovision
description: NeuroVision is a responsive brain-game site with five activities: visual memory, a sliding image puzzle, a timed object guessing game, a hands-on sequence recall challenge, and a fish survival game. Scores, focus points, and game levels are saved in the browser on the current device.

scripts.test: node tests/fish.test.cjs && node tests/three.test.mjs && node tests/pattern.test.cjs
